machines.name: Superstructure goal
machines.description: Where the driver wants the end effector: stowed, at the coral intake, or at a reef level. Each button picks a goal; Motion gets the pivot, elevator and wrist there safely.

STOW.name: Stow
STOW.description: Elevator down, pivot upright, wrist in line.

CORAL_INTAKE.name: Coral intake
CORAL_INTAKE.description: Pivot tipped forward, wrist down to take coral.

L4.name: L4
L4.description: Reef level 4: elevator near full extension.

machines.name: Motion
machines.description: Moves the pivot, elevator and wrist to the goal in a safe order. The pivot swings the whole elevator, so before a big pivot move the elevator is pulled in below the safe height; it extends only once the pivot is there.

sensor.pivotFar: Pivot far from its goal (over 5°, until back within 2°)
sensor.atGoal: Pivot, elevator and wrist at the goal

RETRACTING.name: Retracting
RETRACTING.description: Elevator pulls in below the safe height; the pivot holds where it is.

PIVOTING.name: Pivoting
PIVOTING.description: Elevator held in; pivot and wrist move to the goal.

EXTENDING.name: Extending
EXTENDING.description: Pivot there; elevator and wrist finish moving to the goal.

AT_GOAL.name: At goal
AT_GOAL.description: Everything within tolerance of the goal.

transitions: * -> RETRACTING: pivotFar && !elevatorSafe  # Pull the elevator in first
